test_title: SSC CGL (2022) Tier-II Official Paper (Held On : 3 March 2023)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
Here the correct answer is **Inhibiting**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Option 2, "inhibiting," **is the correct answer to fill in the blank in the given sentence.
 
• The verb** "inhibit" **means **to prevent or hinder something from happening or developing.**
 
• **Example:**
 
 
• Fear can **inhibit **someone from taking risks.
 
 
 
• The sentence refers to the effects of plastic bags on soil nutrients. When plastic bags are littered on the ground, they can inhibit the growth of plants and microorganisms by blocking sunlight and reducing the amount of oxygen and water that can reach the soil.
 
 
• For example, when plastic bags accumulate in a forest, they can prevent sunlight from reaching the forest floor, inhibiting the growth of plants and changing the balance of the forest ecosystem. Similarly, plastic bags that litter agricultural land can reduce crop yields by inhibiting the growth of microorganisms in the soil.
 
 
 
• **Option 1, "accumulating,"** is incorrect as plastic bags do not accumulate soil nutrients, instead, they inhibit soil nutrients.
 
• **Option 3, "demanding," **doesn't fit the context of the sentence, as it doesn't make sense to say that plastic bags are "demanding" soil nutrients.
 
• **Option 4, "converting," **also doesn't fit the context of the sentence, as plastic bags do not convert soil nutrients in any way.

 

Correct Paragraph:__ *The effects of plastic bags on the environment are really (1) __quite__ devastating because there is no disposal method that will really help eliminate the problem. The biggest problem with them is that once they have been (2) __soiled__**, they end up In the trash, which then ends up in the landfill or is burned. The indefinite period of time that it takes for the average plastic bag to break (3) __down__ can be literally hundreds of years. Throughout the world, plastic bags are responsible for suffocation and deaths of woodland animals as well as **(4) __inhibiting__** soil nutrients. The land litter that is made up of plastic bags has the potential to kill over and over again. It has been estimated that one bag has the potential to inadvertently kill one animal per every three months due to unintentional digestion or inhalation. There are always alternatives to plastic bags and the search for more alternatives continues.*
